svg.text: Sahayak Base Car — Full Circuit Diagram (ESP32 side only)
Print reference — not to scale. Pi is powered separately and connects later via serial only.
⚠ Echo pin outputs 5V — ESP32 GPIO is 3.3V max
Use a voltage divider (e.g. 1kΩ + 2kΩ resistors) between
Echo and GPIO5 to step 5V down to ~3.3V before connecting.
Motor rail power (7.4V, direct from battery)
Logic rail power (5V, via SY8205 buck converter)
Common ground (all GND points tied together)
ESP32 → TB6612 control signals (STBY, AIN1/2, PWMA, BIN1/2, PWMB)
1. Wire battery → fuse → switch → confirm ~7.4V at output with multimeter before connecting anything else
2. Wire motor rail (7.4V direct) to TB6612 VM. Wire logic rail through SY8205 buck converter to ESP32 5V pin — confirm 5V output first
